items.title: I Toured the Set of an AI-Hybrid Film. There Are Actors — but No Set (EXCLUSIVE)
items.excerpt: An exclusive set visit to "Terrarium", an AI-hybrid production where 15–20 AI artists generate locations and props around human actors shot on a bare soundstage.

items.title: ‘Unmasking a Monster’: Star, EP, and ID President on Using AI Masks to Perfect Their Aileen Wuornos Look
items.excerpt: ID docuseries "Unmasking a Monster: Aileen Wuornos" used an AI-mask tool in post to make actors look like their real-life counterparts, which its EP calls an industry first.

items.title: Massive Studios, ‘Garfield Movie’ Writers and Producer Todd Garner Team on AI Animated Short Films
items.excerpt: Massive Studios, "The Garfield Movie" writers and producer Todd Garner team on three AI-powered Christmas animated shorts debuting free before year end.

items.title: Utopai Studios Launches New PAI and Utopai X to Advance Production Intelligence for Film and TV
items.excerpt: Utopai Studios launches PAI and Utopai X, production-intelligence tools whose AI agents break a screenplay into scenes and shots and help plan production.

items.title: Reanimated AI Greta Garbo stars again … in a ball-bearing advert
items.excerpt: SKF recreates Greta Garbo with AI for a 99-second advert, built from text prompts rather than copyrighted footage; her heirs say they would not rule out a film role.

items.title: 연상호 '실낙원' 프리퀄 단편 29일 공개…생성형 AI로 제작 | 연합뉴스
items.excerpt: CJ ENM releases "실낙원 - 유니버스", a prequel short series written by Yeon Sang-ho and produced with generative AI; episodes 1–2 on 9/29, 3–4 on 10/6.

items.title: I Tested AI Agents Against a Real AI Artist
items.excerpt: Curious Refuge pits the top AI creative agents against a real AI artist to see how agent output compares to human creative direction.

items.title: 'Doctor Who': BBC's Matt Brittin Says He Has Watched AI Episode
items.excerpt: BBC Director General Matt Brittin says a fully AI-generated 50-minute "Doctor Who" episode he was sent was "pretty good".

items.title: MForMedia & Arcana Labs Sign AI Production Pact For Middle East
items.excerpt: Dubai-based MForMedia partners with Arcana Labs to bring AI workflows into its productions, Arabic co-productions and staff training.

items.title: LightBox Expo 2026: Bobby Chiu And Jim Demonakos On Animation
items.excerpt: LightBox Expo founders explain their strict no-generative-AI policy covering panels and Artist Alley sales.

items.title: Ted Cruz Blocks Senators' Effort To Pass No Fakes Act
items.excerpt: Sen. Ted Cruz blocks a Senate push to pass the No Fakes Act curbing unauthorized AI deepfakes, citing satire and political-commentary exceptions.

items.title: Studio Jadu Launches Venture to Help Indie Creators Make & Grow Animated Shows - Animation Magazine
items.excerpt: Studio Jadu launches a venture to help indie creators make animated shows, with its AI Director's Assistant AIDA turning scripts into animation.

items.title: You can now use ChatGPT and Claude to speed up 3D art in Cinema 4D
items.excerpt: Maxon opens Cinema 4D to ChatGPT and Claude so artists can drive 3D scene work with AI assistants.

items.title: Tom Cruise Slams AI, Defends $125M ‘Digger’ as Reviews Divide Critics: “People Want Real Things”
items.excerpt: Tom Cruise criticizes AI at the "Digger" premiere, saying "people want real things".
